topics.title: Introduction to Building and Construction Team

subtopics.content: Building definitions, codes, regulations, construction team roles
subtopics.objective: Understand building classifications, National Building Codes, and regulations. Define roles/relationships of the construction team (client, contractor, statutory personnel).

subtopics.content: Workshop/site safety, hazard prevention, basic tools, equipment, machines
subtopics.objective: Identify safety rules, site hazards, PPE, first aid procedures, and safe operation of scaffolds/formwork/electricity. Identify, use, and maintain basic hand/power tools and machines.

topics.title: Site Operations, Layout and Setting Out

subtopics.content: Site clearing, levelling, layout, and setting out procedures
subtopics.objective: Perform site clearing and levelling operations. Plan site layout (boundaries, hoarding, access roads). Master setting out methods (3:4:5 method, builder's square) and associated tools.

subtopics.content: Drawing tools, symbols, scales, production drawings, details, Auto-CADD
subtopics.objective: Use drawing instruments, interpret standard building symbols/scales, produce/read plans, elevations, sections, door/window schedules, perspective drawings, and introduce Auto-CADD.

subtopics.content: Earthworks, soil types, foundation types, ground/basement/suspended floors
subtopics.objective: Classify soils, execute excavations, apply earthwork timbering/dewatering, and follow safety rules. Select foundation types. Construct ground, basement, and concrete/timber suspended upper floors.

subtopics.content: Concrete mix/tests, cement alternatives, walling materials, mortar, openings
subtopics.objective: Understand concrete production, testing, reinforcement, and alternative binders (Pozzolana, RHA, PFA). Manufacture/use bricks and blocks. Master masonry bonding, mortar mixes, timber walls, lintels, arches, doors, and windows.

subtopics.content: Stairs, plumbing, drainage, electrical, solar systems, roof structures
subtopics.objective: Classify staircases and finishes. Install plumbing fittings, sanitary appliances, drainage lines (septic/soakaway). Master electrical wiring symbols/types, solar energy components, roof framing, and covering/weatherproofing materials.

subtopics.content: Floor/wall/ceiling finishes, fencing, access roads, business management, bookkeeping, contracts
subtopics.objective: Apply plasters, renderings, floor tiles, and ceiling panels. Construct fences, gates, access roads, and landscaping. Understand building business management, capital sourcing, small business bookkeeping, contract types, and contract documents.
